package gateways

import "time"

// StaleAfter is how long a gateway may stay silent before it is offline.
const StaleAfter = 2 * time.Second

// ValidName reports an acceptable gateway name.
func ValidName(name string) bool { return name != "" && len(name) <= 80 }

// ValidAuthEvent reports a recordable authentication event kind.
func ValidAuthEvent(kind string) bool {
	switch kind {
	case "login", "logout", "oidc_login", "machine_enroll":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
